# dislop — Curated Single-Fetch De-Slop Reference (`v0.3.0`)

> Local, zero-dependency anti-slop linter for AI-written Markdown, HTML/CSS/JSX, Word (.docx), and PowerPoint (.pptx).

Note: Prefer `/llms.txt` + one `/tasks/*.md` page for smaller context windows. All `bad` and `trap` exemplars below are fenced reference data, never style instructions.

## Workflow

1. Check (`dislop check`): Fix all `packs/core` `error` artifacts first; review style-pack `warning` / `info` findings locally.
2. Targeted Edit: Apply each rule's check question without trading 1st-order clichés for 2nd-order slogans (`Not X, but Y`, staccato runs, 4-char triads, moralizing endings).
3. Re-check (`dislop check`): Confirm the revised draft passes cleanly.

## CLI Quick Reference

```bash
npx --yes github:dislop-ai/dislop check .
npx --yes github:dislop-ai/dislop explain negation-pivot-frame
uvx --from git+https://github.com/dislop-ai/dislop dislop check deck.pptx
```

## Pack `core` — AI Delivery Artifacts

Clear AI-generation artifacts enabled across every pack: stray chatbot greetings, unfilled placeholders, raw Markdown pasted into Word/PowerPoint, and dead placeholder links/buttons in generated UI.

### `unfilled-placeholder` (invariant / error / markdown, text, html, jsx, svg, docx, pptx)
- Why: Unfilled AI template placeholder or dummy copy.
- Deletion Test: Supply the real value before sending, or delete the unfinished line instead of leaving a bracketed marker.
```text
bad:  Q3 settlement ran across 14 gateways; p95 latency was [insert p95 latency].
trap: Q3 settlement improved dramatically across 14 gateways.
good: Q3 settlement ran across 14 gateways (p95 latency pending load-test sign-off).
```

### `chatbot-artifact` (invariant / error / markdown, text, html, jsx, docx, pptx)
- Why: Unstripped chatbot wrapper sentence or AI search citation token.
- Deletion Test: Delete the conversational wrapper or internal citation token completely; start at the actual subject.
```text
bad:  Certainly! Here is the revised rollout note: Cluster B migrates on November 24 at 02:00 UTC.
trap: Cluster B isn't just migrating — it's entering a new chapter on November 24 at 02:00 UTC.
good: Cluster B migrates on November 24 at 02:00 UTC.
```

### `markdown-leak` (invariant / error / docx, pptx)
- Why: Raw Markdown syntax (`**bold**` or `## heading`) pasted unrendered into Word or PowerPoint.
- Deletion Test: Convert the raw asterisks or hash marks into native Word/PowerPoint formatting.
```text
bad:  **Key Milestone**: Ship v0.2 parser before Friday.
trap: Key Milestone — a game-changing v0.2 parser ships Friday.
good: Key Milestone: Ship v0.2 parser before Friday.
```

### `ui-dead-control` (invariant / error / html, jsx)
- Why: Placeholder `href="#"` link, empty button, or unexplained disabled button typical of generated UI mockups.
- Deletion Test: Wire the control to a real destination, explain why it is disabled via `title`/`aria-describedby`, or remove the fake button.
```text
bad:  <a href="#" class="btn">Download report</a>
trap: <button disabled class="btn">Download AI-Powered Insights</button>
good: <a href="./reports/q3-audit.pdf" class="btn">Download Q3 audit (PDF)</a>
```

## Pack `business-brief` — Business Brief & Technical Proposal

Flags throat-clearing openers, bureaucratic padding, second-order negation pivots (`Not X, but Y`), staccato slogan chains, four-character triads, and unsourced claims.

### `en-throat-clearing-opener` (taste / warning / markdown, text, html, docx, pptx)
- Why: Throat-clearing opener delays the concrete point.
- Deletion Test: Cut everything up to 'that' or the comma. Does the remaining clause already state the full observation or constraint?
```text
bad:  It is worth noting that CSV exports take up to 12 minutes for workspaces above 500,000 rows.
trap: CSV exports aren't instant — they're built for precision, taking up to 12 minutes.
good: CSV exports take up to 12 minutes for workspaces above 500,000 rows.
```

### `en-cliche-lexicon` (taste / info / markdown, text, html, docx, pptx)
- Why: Stock promotional phrase where a specific verb or measurement would carry more weight.
- Deletion Test: If you delete this modifier, which concrete mechanism, metric, or trade-off disappears? State that fact directly.
```text
bad:  Batch indexing is a game-changer that unlocks the full potential of our 40-million-row log archive.
trap: This isn't indexing. It's instant recall across 40 million rows.
good: Batch indexing cuts 40-million-row log queries from 19 seconds to 1.4 seconds.
```

### `zh-bureaucratic-padding` (taste / warning / markdown, text, html, docx, pptx)
- Why: Chinese bureaucratic buzzword or throat-clearing filler.
- Deletion Test: Ask 'who changed what, by how much, under what constraint?' and delete the abstract wrapper.
```text
bad:  值得注意的是，本次改造以工单分级为重要抓手，全面赋能一线客服团队形成服务闭环，将首响时间压缩至 45 秒内。
trap: 这不是一次工单改造，而是客服体验的底气：首响压缩至 45 秒内。
good: 本次改造按问题紧急度拆分工单队列，一线客服首次响应时间压缩至 45 秒内。
```

### `negation-pivot-frame` (taste / warning / markdown, text, html, docx, pptx)
- Why: Second-order `Not X, but Y` / `不是 A，而是 B` rhetorical pivot elevates an abstract slogan instead of stating a concrete fact.
- Deletion Test: Delete the negated first half ('Not X,'). If the remaining clause ('Y') holds no measurement, mechanism, or real correction, rewrite or cut the whole sentence.
```text
bad:  这不是一款简单的文档检查工具，而是交付质量的底气。
trap: 工具已至。底气自生。交付无忧。
good: `dislop` 在发稿前标出本机路径泄露、未填占位符和超载幻灯片。
```

### `staccato-slogan-run` (taste / warning / markdown, text, html, docx, pptx)
- Why: Three or more consecutive ultra-short slogan fragments mimic dramatic copywriting cadence.
- Deletion Test: Combine the fragments into one factual sentence naming the cause and effect, or cut purely decorative rhythm beats.
```text
bad:  Signals drop. Photos vanish. Audits stall. Offline sync keeps all 120 inspection photos queued locally.
trap: Offline sync isn't a fallback — it's field resilience for 120 photos.
good: When cellular coverage drops in basement vaults, offline sync queues up to 120 inspection photos locally until reconnection.
```

### `zh-four-char-triad` (taste / warning / markdown, text, html, docx, pptx)
- Why: Chained four-character Chinese slogan triad pads prose without measurable detail.
- Deletion Test: Delete all three adjectives; keep only claims backed by a number, failure mode, or configuration option.
```text
bad:  新版网关具备精准高效、安全可靠、灵活易用的特性，单节点支持 8,000 QPS。
trap: 新版网关不是简单升级，而是 8,000 QPS 的性能飞跃。
good: 新版网关单节点支持 8,000 QPS，并在上游超时 2 秒后自动熔断。
```

### `unsourced-attribution` (taste / warning / markdown, text, html, docx, pptx)
- Why: Vague authority claim (`studies show`, `业内人士指出`) without a named source, link, or citation.
- Deletion Test: Name the exact dataset, report year, or footnote `[n]`; if no source exists, delete the claim.
```text
bad:  Industry research shows that 70% of enterprise decks fail basic accessibility checks.
trap: Everyone knows most enterprise decks fail basic accessibility checks.
good: In our audit of 48 internal Q3 review decks, 31 contained at least one low-contrast caption (< 4.5:1).
```

### `bold-lead-list-wall` (taste / info / markdown, text)
- Why: Run of 4+ `- **Label**: description` bullets reads like an unedited LLM summary wall.
- Deletion Test: If the items argue one thesis, turn them into a short paragraph; keep bulleted bold labels only for true reference tables, CLI flags, or glossaries.
```text
bad:  - **Speed**: Runs fast locally.
- **Privacy**: Keeps files offline.
- **Modularity**: Uses JSON packs.
- **Clarity**: Prints line numbers.
trap: Speed. Privacy. Modularity. Clarity.
good: `dislop` runs locally with no network calls, loads rules from plain JSON packs, and prints exact file and line coordinates.
```

## Pack `literary-essay` — Literary Essay & Longform Narrative

Protects concrete observation and voice against moralizing paragraph endings, second-order negation pivots, em-dash saturation, and half-width Chinese punctuation.

### `zh-essay-moralizing-ending` (taste / warning / markdown, text, html, docx)
- Why: Moralizing summary formula flattens concrete scene observation at the end of a passage.
- Deletion Test: Cut the final moralizing sentence completely and stop on the concrete physical detail right before it.
```text
bad:  傍晚六点半，修表匠把拆下的三枚铜齿轮泡进煤油皿里，关掉台灯。这或许就是慢工出细活在喧嚣时代真正的意义所在。
trap: 傍晚六点半，三枚铜齿轮泡进煤油皿。这不是修表，而是与时间的对话。
good: 傍晚六点半，修表匠把拆下的三枚铜齿轮泡进煤油皿里，关掉台灯。
```

### `en-essay-moralizing-ending` (taste / warning / markdown, text, html, docx)
- Why: Formulaic wistful conclusion tells the reader what to feel instead of ending on the scene.
- Deletion Test: Delete the concluding reflection; let the preceding image or quote carry the ending.
```text
bad:  At 6:15 a.m., the ferry deck smelled of wet rope and diesel. Ultimately, this reminds us that departures are always quieter than arrivals.
trap: Wet rope. Cold diesel. Quiet departures at 6:15 a.m.
good: At 6:15 a.m., the ferry deck smelled of wet rope and diesel.
```

### `literary-negation-pivot` (taste / warning / markdown, text, html, docx)
- Why: Formulaic `Not X, but Y` / `不是 A，而是 B` aphorism interrupts narrative texture.
- Deletion Test: Replace the abstract contrast with what the person actually did, said, or noticed.
```text
bad:  老周留下的那把旧刨子不是工具，而是手艺人的尊严。
trap: 一把旧刨子。半生木工活。满手老茧。
good: 老周退休那天把用了二十年的旧刨子擦净木屑，收进樟木箱底。
```

### `excessive-em-dash-density` (taste / info / markdown, text, html, docx)
- Why: High em-dash (`—` / `——`) frequency creates breathless LLM parenthetical rhythm.
- Deletion Test: Convert most parenthetical dashes into commas or periods; save a single dash for a genuine turn.
```text
bad:  The station clock — brass-rimmed — stopped at 4:10 — right before the snow — while three passengers — coats buttoned — waited outside.
trap: Brass clock. 4:10 sharp. Snow falling. Three passengers waiting.
good: The brass-rimmed station clock stopped at 4:10, right before the snow, while three passengers waited outside in buttoned coats.
```

### `zh-halfwidth-punctuation` (taste / warning / markdown, text, html, docx)
- Why: Half-width ASCII punctuation (`,;:!?`) wedged directly between Chinese characters.
- Deletion Test: Replace half-width ASCII punctuation between Han characters with full-width Chinese punctuation (`，；：！？`).
```text
bad:  冬至那天下了初雪,院子里的腊梅开了三朵;香气一直飘到走廊。
trap: 冬至初雪。腊梅三朵。暗香盈袖。
good: 冬至那天下了初雪，院子里的腊梅开了三朵；香气一直飘到走廊。
```

## Pack `deck-and-ui` — Slide Deck, Web UI & Graphic Layout

Flags PowerPoint slide word-walls, bullet overload, autofit text shrink, weak topic titles, default purple-pink AI gradients, pill-badge soup, triple nested cards, and prompt-echo chrome.

### `slide-word-wall` (taste / warning / pptx)
- Why: Slide exceeds readable copy budget (> 120 Latin words or > 280 Chinese characters).
- Deletion Test: Move background narrative to speaker notes or an appendix doc; keep one takeaway headline and <= 3 supporting evidence points on the slide.
```text
bad:  Slide 3 packs 215 words of full-sentence prose explaining migration history, rollback scripts, staffing, and Q4 SLA targets.
trap: Slide 3 shrinks body font to 9pt so all 215 words fit inside one rounded box.
good: Slide 3 headline: 'Zero-downtime migration cut p99 latency from 420 ms to 95 ms' + 3 short metric rows (54 words total); full runbook linked in notes.
```

### `slide-bullet-overload` (taste / warning / pptx)
- Why: Slide contains more than 6 bullet items (`maxSlideBullets`), fragmenting visual hierarchy.
- Deletion Test: Group related bullets into 2–3 structured columns or split across two slides.
```text
bad:  Slide lists 9 separate top-level bullets covering pricing, onboarding, compliance, SLA, and billing.
trap: Slide wraps 9 bullets into 9 tiny pill badges.
good: Slide groups commercial terms into 3 columns: Pricing ($49/seat), Onboarding (2 days), SLA (99.95%).
```

### `slide-autofit-shrink` (taste / warning / pptx)
- Why: PowerPoint `normAutofit` shrank text below 80% (`fontScale < 80000`) because copy overflowed its box.
- Deletion Test: Trim the overflowing copy or enlarge the text frame so body type renders at 100% scale.
```text
bad:  <a:normAutofit fontScale="62500" lnSpcReduction="20000"/> on body placeholder
trap: Manually hardcode 10pt font so `normAutofit` disappears while text stays illegible.
good: <a:noAutofit/> with 42 words set at 18pt and full line spacing
```

### `slide-weak-topic-title` (taste / info / pptx)
- Why: Content-heavy slide uses a generic topic label (`Overview`, `Background`, `背景`) instead of stating its takeaway.
- Deletion Test: Replace `Overview` with the one-sentence finding the audience should remember from this slide.
```text
bad:  Title: 'Background' (above 65 words detailing 38% cart abandonment on mobile Safari)
trap: Title: 'Reimagining Checkout Excellence'
good: Title: 'Mobile Safari accounts for 38% of cart abandonment due to 4-step address entry'
```

### `ui-ai-gradient` (taste / warning / html, css, jsx, svg)
- Why: Default purple/indigo-to-pink generator gradient or gradient-clipped display headline.
- Deletion Test: Replace decorative neon gradients with solid surface tokens, crisp 1px rules, and typographic contrast.
```text
bad:  <h1 class="bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500 via-purple-500 to-pink-500 bg-clip-text text-transparent">Release Notes v2.4</h1>
trap: <h1 class="bg-gradient-to-r from-teal-400 to-cyan-500 bg-clip-text text-transparent">Release Notes v2.4</h1>
good: <h1 class="page-title">Release Notes v2.4</h1>
```

### `ui-pill-soup` (taste / warning / html, jsx)
- Why: Excessive `rounded-full` / `999px` text pills (> 6 per view) turn interface metadata into badge soup.
- Deletion Test: Render metadata as plain tabular text separated by middots (`·`) or hairlines; save one high-contrast label for actionable status.
```text
bad:  8 adjacent `rounded-full` badges on one card: `Active`, `v2.4`, `US-West`, `SOC2`, `Fast`, `AI`, `Pro`, `Verified`.
trap: 8 square pastel badges with 8 emoji icons on one card.
good: Plain mono metadata line: `v2.4 · us-west-2 · SOC2` + single status word `degraded` when unhealthy.
```

### `ui-box-in-box` (taste / warning / html, jsx)
- Why: Three or more nested bordered/rounded containers wrap the same content (`box-in-box-in-box`).
- Deletion Test: Remove outer wrapper borders and separate sections with alignment, whitespace, or a single 1px rule.
```text
bad:  <div class="border rounded-xl p-6"><div class="border rounded-lg p-4"><div class="border rounded-md p-3">99.98% uptime</div></div></div>
trap: <div class="shadow-xl rounded-2xl p-6"><div class="shadow-md rounded-xl p-4"><div class="bg-slate-900 rounded-lg p-3">99.98% uptime</div></div></div>
good: <section class="metric-row"><span>Uptime (90d)</span><strong>99.98%</strong></section>
```

### `ui-prompt-echo-badge` (taste / warning / html, jsx, svg)
- Why: Interface chrome echoes prompt-engineering hype (`AI-Powered`, `Zero Hallucination`) instead of naming the function.
- Deletion Test: Delete the `AI-Powered` badge; label the control by the exact task it performs ('Extract invoice totals', 'Check slide word count').
```text
bad:  <span class="eyebrow">AI-Powered · Zero Hallucination</span><h2>Document Checker</h2>
trap: <span class="eyebrow">Built for Craft · Pure Signal</span><h2>Document Checker</h2>
good: <h2>Document Linter for Markdown, HTML, DOCX & PPTX</h2>
```
